opportunities.name: Siphon movement attack
opportunities.objective: Explore repeated attack contact during the augmented Q shield and speed window.
opportunities.mechanic: Q grants an AP shield and a next attack dealing magic damage with 0.5 AP plus AD; augmentation multiplies shield by 1.6 and grants 30% move speed. Dusk and Dawn and Nashor supply item attack packets while Cosmic adds magic-contact movement. W provides a delayed stun only if the victim remains inside 1.25 seconds.
opportunities.requiredState: Earn Q augment through finite fragments and complete the attack within four seconds.
opportunities.failure: Extra attacks leave W zone or expose Viktor after the 2.5-second shield expires.
opportunities.test: Separate Q cast, empowered magic attack and item packets while measuring shield duration/attack uptime.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits do not mean two Q empowerment consumptions.

opportunities.name: Growing storm cleanup
opportunities.objective: Test continued magic debuff contact as an upgraded storm grows after finite takedowns.
opportunities.mechanic: R lasts 6.5 seconds, deals initial plus per-second AP magic damage, and its upgrade extends size/duration three seconds per damaged-champion death up to six times. Bloodletter and Liandry reward confirmed damage contact while Malignance tests ultimate-ground interaction. Cosmic supports manual storm shepherding and E aftershock if augmented.
opportunities.requiredState: Record earned R upgrade, target path and actual takedowns/extension count.
opportunities.failure: Storm leaves targets or no deaths occur; the supposed cleanup ramp never starts.
opportunities.test: Count R ticks and extension events at zero versus two takedowns, isolating Hatefog refresh.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A six-extension cap does not grant all six extensions at fight start.

ruledOut.reason: R upgrade specifies three-second extension per damaged-target death with a maximum of six events.

unknowns: Dusk Q duplication and R item-proc cadence need logs; upgraded E/W/R must be earned from recorded fragments.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Extra attacks leave W zone or expose Viktor after the 2.5-second shield expires.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits do not mean two Q empowerment consumptions.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Dusk and Dawn, Nashor's Tooth, Cosmic Drive, Riftmaker, Void Staff, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Killing cannon minions grants [10] Hex Fragments.
Champion takedowns grant [20] Hex Fragments.

Viktor deploys a gravitational imprisonment device for [4] seconds, Slowing enemies inside it by [(-33 / -36 / -39 / -42 / -45) × -1]%. Enemies who remain within its radius for 1.25 seconds are Stunned for [1.5] seconds.

Upgraded Passive: Viktor's Abilities Slow by [20]% for 1 second.

Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing [60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and granting Viktor [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 140; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (0.5) × AP + (1) × AD] magic damage.

Upgraded: Grants [(characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 140; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP) × (1.6)] Shield and Viktor additionally gains [30]% Move Speed for [2.5] seconds.
